Exceptional MS or MTech graduates with at least three years of turbomachinery design experience in industry or a national laboratory will be considered at Senior Project Engineer level.

how_to_apply: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the IIT Madras Postdoctoral Researcher Recruitment 2026.
Applications must be submitted online on or before 19-10-2026.
To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.
Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIT Madras to complete the application.
Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details.
Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
Review all details carefully before submitting the form.
Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the Indian Institute of Technology Madras (IIT Madras) through its Industrial Consultancy and Sponsored Research (ICSR) cell for temporary research positions.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised by IIT Madras?
faq.answer: IIT Madras has advertised for the temporary position of Postdoctoral Researcher under advertisement number ICSR/PR/Advt.204/2026 in the Department of Applied Mechanics and Biomedical Engineering.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for this recruitment?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Postdoctoral Researcher position in this recruitment notification released by the Indian Institute of Technology Madras.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to submit the online application?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form for the IIT Madras Postdoctoral Researcher recruitment is 19 October 2026. Candidates must complete their submissions before this deadline.

faq.question: Q5. What is the educational qualification required for the Postdoctoral Researcher post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a PhD in mechanical or aerospace engineering with a thesis in turbomachinery, rotordynamics, or a closely related field to be eligible for this position.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary range for the IIT Madras Postdoctoral Researcher post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Postdoctoral Researcher position will receive a consolidated monthly salary ranging between Rs. 90,000 and Rs. 1,30,000 based on qualifications and experience.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted strictly in online mode through the official career portal provided by IIT Madras ICSR website. No offline or physical applications will be accepted.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee required to apply?
faq.answer: There is no application fee mentioned in the official notification for applying to the Postdoctoral Researcher position at the Indian Institute of Technology Madras.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for IIT Madras Postdoctoral Researcher?
faq.answer: The selection process involves initial short-listing of applications followed by a test or personal interview conducted by the competent selection committee of the institute.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I apply online for this IIT Madras job?
faq.answer: Eligible and interested candidates can apply online directly through the official application portal link provided on the IIT Madras ICSR careers webpage before the final closing date.
